game.title: Sniper Elite V2
game.blurb: World War II tactical stealth sniper shooter from Rebellion, published by 505 Games and Rebellion, released 2012-05-01. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the eleven missions described in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Missions 1 to 4
chapters.summary: Escaping the German assault, stopping the convoy, the V2 facility and holding off the Russian advance.

chapters.title: Missions 5 to 8
chapters.summary: Stopping the execution, the church intel, Müller and Wolff's plan. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Missions 9 to 11
chapters.summary: Finding the launch site, the V2 rocket and stopping Wolff. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Mission Feats
chapters.summary: Optional feats inside missions: the convoy from the ground, the rooftop sniper team, the bridge and the tower.

chapters.title: Bottles and Gold Bars
chapters.summary: Sniping every hidden bottle and finding every stolen gold bar.

chapters.title: Highest Difficulty and Perfect Runs
chapters.summary: All missions on the highest difficulty, a level with 100% rifle accuracy, and a level without being shot.

chapters.title: Co-op Modes
chapters.summary: Overwatch missions as spotter and sniper, Bombing Run, reviving your partner and explosive shots.

chapters.title: Extra Missions
chapters.summary: Neudorf Outpost, Landwehr Canal and Saint Pierre.

chapters.title: Sniping and Combat
chapters.summary: Long shots, headshots, eye shots, ricochets, moving targets, trip mines, sound masking, explosives and stealth kills.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3892); RAWG keeps "Sniper Elite V2 Remastered" (2019) separately. The Steam store list has both app 63380 "Sniper Elite V2" and app 728740 "Sniper Elite V2 Remastered"; since this entry is the 2012 original, its own app 63380 was used (schema name is the placeholder "ValveTestApp63380"; it returned 47 achievements with percentages). If the original is no longer sold, the Remastered app may be the better list later. None of the 47 are hidden. The eleven mission achievements (API GOAL_1 to GOAL_11) are numbered, and the chapters split them 4, 4 and 3, our own choice. Six achievements with DLC API names name Neudorf Outpost, Landwehr Canal and Saint Pierre; the pack names are not in the data. "Detonator" (career explosive shots) has a COOP API name and was placed in co-op for that reason. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs): Gameplay, Table of Contents and Walkthrough are linked, but no subpages exist. sniperelite.fandom.com answers the API with about 86 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
